blurb: Students enroll typically between ages 4.5 and 6 years old and continue through high school. Classes focus on ballet, tap, and modern dance technique, with an emphasis on athleticism, musicality, and self-expression. The studio produces two capstone productions each season involving student choreography and costume construction.
extraNote: No refunds or discounts for student absences; refunds or make-up lessons if instructor is ill · No drop-in classes allowed; placement must be arranged before first class · Studio at 1095 Malone Road, San Jose, CA 95125 · Regular season runs August through mid June
